template_text: Happy Birthday {{name}}! 🎂 Wishing you a day as wonderful as you are. May this year bring you joy, health, and everything your heart desires.
Hey {{name}}! Happy Birthday! 🎉 Hope your day is absolutely amazing — you deserve all the good things!
Arre {{name}}! It's your birthday! 🥳 Time to eat cake, make wishes, and pretend you're not getting older. Have a blast!
Dear {{name}}, warmest birthday greetings to you. May this special day mark the beginning of a year filled with success and good health.
{{name}} को जन्मदिन की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएं! 🎂 भगवान आपको सदा खुश और स्वस्थ रखें। आपका यह साल बहुत शुभ हो।
अरे {{name}} यार! जन्मदिन मुबारक हो! 🎉 खूब मस्ती करो आज, पार्टी करो!
{{name}} भाई/दीदी! Happy Birthday! 🥳 एक और साल बड़े हो गए, पर हम तो वैसे ही रहेंगे! केक कहाँ है?
आदरणीय {{name}}, आपको जन्मदिन की हार्दिक बधाई एवं शुभकामनाएं। ईश्वर आपको दीर्घायु और सुखमय जीवन प्रदान करें।
Happy Birthday {{name}}! 🎂 Yaar, aaj ka din bahut khaas hai — tumhara! Dil se wish kar raha/rahi hoon ki ye saal tumhare liye best ho!
Aye {{name}}! Birthday mubarak ho bhai! 🎉 Party karo, cake khao, aur enjoy karo pura din!
Oye {{name}}! Happy Birthday! 🥳 Ek aur saal beet gaya, par tu toh waise hi bindaas hai! Cake cut kar jaldi!
{{name}}, aapko janamdin ki bahut bahut badhaai! 🎂 Ishwar aapko lambi umar aur khushiyon se bhara jeevan de.
Happy Anniversary {{name}}! 💍 Wishing you both a lifetime of love, laughter, and beautiful moments together.
Happy Anniversary {{name}}! 💕 Hope you guys have a wonderful day celebrating your special bond!
Happy Anniversary {{name}}! 🎊 Another year of putting up with each other — and making it look easy! Cheers to you both!
Warmest congratulations on your anniversary, {{name}}. May your bond continue to grow stronger with each passing year.
{{name}}, शादी की सालगिरह बहुत-बहुत मुबारक हो! 💍 आप दोनों की जोड़ी सदा सलामत रहे और प्यार यूँ ही बना रहे।
{{name}} यार! Anniversary mubarak! 🎊 Itne saal saath nibhaaya — yahi toh asli pyaar hai! Celebrate karo khub!
Happy Anniversary {{name}}! 💍 Aap dono ki jodi really amazing hai. Bhagwan kare yeh pyaar aur bhi gehraata rahe!
Arre {{name}}! Anniversary mubarak ho! 💕 Saath mein itne saal — bahut khoobsurat safar raha hoga. Enjoy karo!
Wishing you and your family a very Happy Diwali {{name}}! 🪔 May the festival of lights fill your home with joy, prosperity, and love.
Happy Diwali {{name}}! 🎆 Hope your celebrations are bright, your sweets are sweet, and your year ahead is amazing!
Happy Diwali {{name}}! 🪔🎇 May your diya burn bright, your rangoli be Instagram-worthy, and your mithai never run out!
{{name}}, दीपावली की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएं! 🪔 माँ लक्ष्मी की कृपा आप पर सदा बनी रहे। आपका घर सुख-समृद्धि से भरा रहे।
{{name}} यार! दिवाली मुबारक हो! 🎆 खूब पटाखे फोड़ो, मिठाई खाओ और मस्ती करो!
Shubh Diwali {{name}}! 🪔 Is tyohar ka prakash aapke ghar mein khushi aur samriddhi le aaye. Dil se wish kar raha/rahi hoon!
Happy Diwali {{name}}! 🎇 Diyas jalao, mithai khao, aur sab ke saath celebrate karo. Bahut maza aaye!
Oye {{name}}! Diwali mubarak! 🪔✨ Rangoliyan banao, patakhe jalao, aur neighbour se zyada roshni karo ghar mein!
Happy Holi {{name}}! 🎨 May the colours of this festival brighten your life and fill it with happiness and good cheer!
Happy Holi {{name}}! 🌈 Get ready to be covered in colour — no white clothes allowed today! Have a blast!
Happy Holi {{name}}! 🎨 Rang, gulal aur khushiyon se bhara ye tyohar aapki zindagi mein har roz ke rangon ko aur khoobsurat bana de!
Bura na mano Holi hai {{name}}! 🌈 Pichkaari ready hai kya? Aaj toh dil khol ke rangon mein doob jaao!
{{name}}, होली की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएं! 🎨 यह रंगों का त्योहार आपके जीवन में ढेरों खुशियाँ और रंग भर दे।
Merry Christmas {{name}}! 🎄 Wishing you and your family a season filled with love, warmth, and the magic of Christmas.
Merry Christmas {{name}}! 🎅 Hope Santa's been good to you this year! Enjoy the celebrations!
Merry Christmas {{name}}! 🎄🎁 May your tree be bright, your gifts be plenty, and your eggnog be strong! Ho ho ho!
Season's Greetings {{name}}. Wishing you a blessed and joyful Christmas and a prosperous New Year ahead.
Merry Christmas {{name}}! 🎄 Is khoobsurat tyohar mein aapke ghar mein khushi, pyaar aur sukoon bana rahe. Have a wonderful celebration!
Happy Christmas {{name}}! 🎅🎁 Santa toh aaya hoga zaroor — aakhir aap toh nice list mein hain! Enjoy karo!
Happy New Year {{name}}! 🎉 May 2027 bring you abundant joy, good health, and all the success you deserve. Here's to new beginnings!
Happy New Year {{name}}! 🥂 Hope this year is your best one yet — cheers to new adventures and great memories!
Happy New Year {{name}}! 🎊 Out with the old, in with the new — and in with better decisions than last year! Have an epic 2027!
Wishing you a very Happy and Prosperous New Year {{name}}. May this year bring you success, good health, and peace.
{{name}}, नए साल की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएं! 🎉 यह नया साल आपके लिए ढेरों खुशियाँ, सेहत और तरक्की लेकर आए।
Happy New Year {{name}}! 🎊 Naya saal aapke liye dher saari khushiyan, sehat aur kamyabi lekar aaye. Dil se wish!
Yaar {{name}}! Naya Saal Mubarak! 🥂 Is saal kuch naya karo, kuch alag karo — aur bahut maza karo!
Happy New Year {{name}}! 🎉 Last year ke saare drama bhool jao — naya saal, naya josh, naya hungama! Let's go!
